record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal z(N0), let S_+ and S_- denote the forward and backward shifts on z(N0), let r(S_+|z) and r(S_-|z) be their spectral radii, and let σ_Φ denote the Φ-spectrum. Determine whether the Φ-spectrum of each shift is always the closed annulus {lambda in C : r(S_\mp|z)^(-1) <= |lambda| <= r(S_\pm|z)}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ be a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal: that is, a linear subspace of $\mathbb{C}^{\mathbb{N}_0}$ equipped with a complete quasi-norm $\|\cdot\|_z$ such that both the forward shift $S_+:(x_0,x_1,x_2,\dots)\mapsto(0,x_0,x_1,\dots)$ and the backward shift $S_-:(x_0,x_1,x_2,\dots)\mapsto(x_1,x_2,x_3,\dots)$ are bounded operators on $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$. Let $r(S_+\mid z)$ and $r(S_-\mid z)$ denote their respective spectral radii in the Banach algebra of bounded linear operators on $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$.

For a bounded linear operator $T$ on a quasi-Banach space, define the $\Phi$-spectrum $\sigma_\Phi(T)$ to be the set of all $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$ such that $\lambda I - T$ is not a Fredholm operator (i.e., does not have closed range with finite-dimensional kernel and cokernel).

Determine whether, for every such $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$,
$$\sigma_\Phi(S_\pm \mid z) \;=\; \bigl\{\lambda \in \mathbb{C} : r(S_\mp\mid z)^{-1} \le |\lambda| \le r(S_\pm\mid z)\bigr\}.$$
artifact.category_tag: Operator ideals and spectra of shift operators
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem in Pietsch's work on traces on operator ideals over Banach spaces. A web search found related literature on spectra of weighted shifts and on shift operators in connection with traces, but no source establishing or refuting the claimed annulus description for the $\Phi$-spectrum of the forward/backward shifts on a general quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal.

status_evidence.title: The Spectrum of Shift Operators and the Existence of Traces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies spectra of shift operators on shift-monotone sequence ideals in connection with traces.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related setup; does not resolve the Φ-spectrum annulus question.

status_evidence.title: On the spectrum of weighted shifts (arXiv:2210.01510)
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates spectra of weighted shifts on sequence spaces, often annular in shape.
status_evidence.claim: Relevant background but not a resolution of this specific problem.
